name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer
description: A dark card shaped like a receipt printer. It prints a coffee receipt line by line, then you drag the paper down to rip it off and watch it tumble away.
use: A playful order confirmation or checkout flourish, where the printed receipt itself is the reward.
avoid: The card is a hard 288px wide and 480px tall, so it will not fit a narrow column or short panel.
a11y: Print and tear have keyboard buttons, but the stretch-and-drag gesture has no keyboard equivalent. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A tall dark rounded card with a grey printer head across the top showing a shop name and a status word. Below it a white receipt hangs with a serrated bottom edge, monospace text, dotted dividers and a barcode.
behaves: When it scrolls into view the receipt feeds out line by line while the head buzzes. Pulling the paper stretches it from the slot, and a sharp drag tears it so it falls and spins out of view; a button prints another.
customise: Merchant, order number, date, the item array, tax rate and currency symbol are props; the look, feed timing and physics constants live in the file.
weight: moderate: Fixed-step physics runs at 120 steps a second, but only while printing or falling.
